scope: Offline-only feature-family contracts for future native current and BCF MC1 research maps. No model bundle, calibration artifact, policy, portfolio, exchange, or live inference path was modified.

implementation.canonical_control: M0 retains the ordered six-field canonical contract: final_score, base_rank42, conditional_consensus_rank, upstream, ordinary_shadow_consensus_rank, correctness_rank.
implementation.target_free_guard: Feature contracts reject policy_, label_, outcome_, and target_ fields and reject missing or duplicate names.
implementation.native_separation: The module builds contracts per supplied score-family frame only; it has no current/BCF join or cross-family field source.
implementation.cross_layer_geometry: M3 fields derive only layer consensus, corrections, support, and OOD values. Realized outcomes remain MC1 targets and are excluded from inference inputs.
implementation.complexity_cap: Contracts fail rather than silently truncate when more than 24 selected fields are requested.

validation_evidence.result: 3 focused tests passed; outcome-field rejection, cross-layer directionality, deterministic exact-duplicate elimination, and canonical ordering were verified.
